ai-zombie-openapi-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the ai-zombie skill for WeShop OpenAPI.
- Transform portrait images into realistic zombies using a secure API.
- Supports image upload, customizable zombie transformation text, and batch generation (up to 16 images).
- Requires HTTPS access and WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Includes clear API key handling and security instructions.
